title: Improving payment for essential services: a field experiment in Nairobi, Kenya
Income redistribution, water scarcity and water rates in the 225 largest US cities
abstract: As in the electricity sector, water utilities commonly use increasing block tariffs despite economists’ theoretical advice to set the volumetric price at the long-run marginal cost of supply. The common justification is to shift costs away from lower-income users (presumed to use less water) and to provide conservation incentives in the face of scarcity. Following a recent paper in the electricity sector, we calculate water and sewer rate progressivity for 225 US cities and explore whether this measure is related to local water scarcity and income inequality. We combine data on rates, customer assistance programs, county-level Census demographics, utility characteristics, and presidential vote shares with a nationwide dataset on water consumption. We also introduce a long-term measure of water scarcity to the debate on whether customers in water-scarce regions really face higher prices. As in the electricity sector, we find that water rates are more redistributive in areas with higher income inequality and that customer assistance programs seem not to be a substitute for increasing block tariffs. We find little evidence that rates are more redistributive in water-scarce areas. We discuss whether, as in electricity, redistributive water tariffs may be ineffective at providing much assistance to lower-income customers.
abstract_zh: 与电力行业一样，水务公司普遍采用递增区块水价，尽管经济学家在理论上建议将单位水量价格设定为长期供给的边际成本。常见的理由是，这种定价可以将成本从低收入用户（假定其用水量较少）身上转移开，并在面临稀缺性时提供节约激励。借鉴电力行业的一项近期研究，我们计算了美国225个城市的水费和污水处理费累进性，并探讨该指标是否与当地水资源稀缺性和收入不平等相关。我们将水价与客户援助项目数据、县级人口普查人口统计数据、公用事业特征数据、总统选举得票率数据，与一份全国性的用水量数据集相结合。我们还引入了一项长期水资源稀缺性指标，以探讨在水资源稀缺地区的客户是否真的面临更高价格这一争论。与电力行业一样，我们发现，在收入不平等程度较高的地区，水价的再分配性更强，而且客户援助项目似乎无法替代递增区块水价。我们几乎没有发现证据表明，水资源稀缺地区的水价更具再分配性。我们讨论了，与电力行业类似，具有再分配性的水价是否可能对低收入客户几乎无法提供实质性帮助。

Peer effects in voluntary environmental policies: An application to urban water quality
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Stormwater runoff is a growing source of urban water pollution, costing cities billions of dollars. We investigate peer effects in a voluntary residential green stormwater infrastructure program that mitigates stormwater runoff. Our identification strategy exploits households’ relative position in eligible sewersheds that generates plausibly exogenous variation in eligible peers. Peer adoption causes a 0.2% increase in the annual adoption probability, a 66% increase relative to the mean. According to our calculations, the policy reduced compliance costs by $85–$235 million for the Seattle metropolitan area, of which roughly 40% is due to peer effects.
abstract_zh: 雨水径流是城市水污染日益严重的来源，给城市造成了数十亿美元的损失。我们研究了一个自愿性质的住宅绿色雨水基础设施项目中的同伴效应，该项目可减缓雨水径流。我们的识别策略利用了住户在符合条件的排水流域中的相对位置，从而产生了看似外生的符合条件同伴的变化。同伴的采用使年采用概率提高了0.2%，相对于均值增加了66%。根据我们的计算，该政策使西雅图大都市区的合规成本降低了8,500万至2.35亿美元，其中约40%归因于同伴效应。

title: The short-run impacts of reducing water collection times on time use, well-being and education in rural Kenya
abstract: Millions of households devote significant energy and time collecting water. To investigate the impacts of this burden, we used a free water delivery treatment to reduce collection times to zero for randomly chosen households in rural Kenya. Data on time use and well-being come from short surveys (n=9,201) completed by 222 respondents several times each day over 6 weeks. Parents reported school attendance and study times for school-aged children. Of the approximately 120 minutes per day of water collection that the treatment eliminated, respondents reallocated approximately half to other household work and half to leisure and socializing. We find no evidence of an increase in paid work on on-farm labor. Treatment caused respondents to report feeling happier. Nonexperimental, high-frequency evidence suggests that water collection is associated with having less energy and more physical pain. Treatment increased self-reported but not school-recorded attendance, and children reallocated time savings to other chores. A significant limitation is that the short treatment period of 2 weeks will miss long-run changes if water became more durably convenient and accessible.
abstract_zh: 数以百万计的家庭花费大量精力和时间取水。为考察这一负担的影响，我们采用了一项免费的供水处理，使肯尼亚农村地区随机选取的家庭取水时间降至零。时间利用与福祉数据来自简短的调查（n=9,201），由222名受访者在6周内每天多次完成。家长报告了学龄儿童的上学情况和学习时间。该处理消除了每天约120分钟的取水时间，受访者将其中约一半重新分配给其他家务劳动，另一半用于休闲与社交。我们没有发现有偿工作或农场劳动增加的证据。该处理使受访者报告感觉更加快乐。非实验性的高频证据表明，取水与精力不足和身体疼痛增加有关。该处理增加了自我报告的上学出勤率，但学校记录的出勤率没有增加；儿童将节省下来的时间用于其他家务。一个重要的局限在于，2周的短期处理期将无法捕捉到在水资源变得更持久便利、更易获取时可能出现的长期变化。

title: Out of sight, out of mind: Household perceptions of `fair' water prices in Nairobi, Kenya
abstract: Providing piped water and sewer services is extremely capital intensive, yet most of this infrastructure is buried, hidden from citizens and ratepayers. Roman emperors built elaborate public fountains to increase the salience of massive infrastructure investments to the public, yet modern households give scarce thought to the water network that serves them. At the same time, tariffs are often too low to recover operations and maintenance costs, let alone capital replacement and system expansion. We use a field experiment to investigate whether providing 353 households in Nairobi, Kenya with information about the water infrastructure that serves them changes their perceptions of water and sewer bills. Compared to a control group, we find that providing households verbal and visual information (in person) about the capital intensity of water service delivery in Nairobi increased their perceptions of “fair” water bills by 15%–24% above the control mean of 404 KSH/mo.
abstract_zh: 提供管道供水和污水处理服务的资本密集度极高，但这些基础设施大部分埋于地下，对公民和纳税人而言是隐形的。古罗马皇帝修建了精致的公共喷泉，以提高公众对大规模基础设施投资的关注，然而，现代家庭却很少考虑为其供水的管网。与此同时，水价往往过低，甚至难以覆盖运营与维护成本，更遑论资本更新和系统扩建。我们开展了一项实地实验，探究向肯尼亚内罗毕353户家庭提供其所用供水基础设施的信息，是否会改变他们对水费和污水处理费的看法。与对照组相比，我们发现，当面对面地向家庭提供关于内罗毕供水服务资本密集度的口头和视觉信息后，他们认为“公平”水费的数额比对照组均值（404肯尼亚先令/月）高出15%—24%。

title: Happy at work in Africa? Measuring hedonic well-being among water carriers in rural Kenya using the Experience Sampling Method
The effects of eligibility and voluntary participation on the distribution of benefits in environmental programs: an application to green stormwater infrastructure
abstract: Many cities provide incentives for private landowners to install green stormwater infrastructure (GSI) to reduce stormwater runoff and deliver benefits of urban greening. We analyze how participation in a GSI subsidy program affects the spatial distribution of urban greening. The distributional effects manifest in two stages: program eligibility and participation decisions. Eligibility, determined by hydrological factors, is positively correlated with wealthier and Whiter areas. In eligible areas, the wealthiest households and least White neighborhoods have lower participation rates. The findings highlight the importance of considering eligibility and participation in balancing the joint goals of environmental quality and environmental justice.
abstract_zh: 许多城市为私人土地所有者安装绿色雨水基础设施（GSI）提供激励，以减少雨水径流并带来城市绿化的效益。我们分析了参与GSI补贴计划如何影响城市绿化的空间分布。分配效应体现在两个阶段：项目资格认定和参与决策。由水文因素决定的资格认定，与较富裕、白人比例较高的地区呈正相关。在符合资格的地区，最富裕的家庭和白人比例最低的社区参与率较低。研究结果凸显了在平衡环境质量与环境正义这两大共同目标时，考虑资格认定与参与情况的重要性。

A decision support tool for rural water supply planning
venue: Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development
abstract: Over a dozen studies have examined how households who travel to collect water (about one-quarter of humanity) make choices about where and how much to collect. There is little evidence, however, that these studies have informed rural water supply planning in anything but a qualitative way. In this paper, we describe a new web-based decision support tool that planners or community members can use to simulate scenarios such as (1) price, quality, or placement changes of existing sources, (2) the closure of an existing source, or (3) the addition of a new source. We describe the analytical structure of the model and then demonstrate its possibilities using data from a recent study in rural Meru County, Kenya. We discuss some limits of the current model, and encourage readers and practitioners to explore it and suggest ways in which it could be improved or used most effectively.
abstract_zh: 已有十余项研究考察了前往取水的家庭（约占全人类的四分之一）如何选择取水地点和取水量。然而，几乎没有证据表明，这些研究在农村供水规划中发挥了除定性层面以外的作用。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新的基于网络的决策支持工具，规划者或社区成员可利用它模拟以下情景：（1）现有水源的价格、水质或位置变化；（2）现有水源的关闭；或（3）新水源的增设。我们阐述了模型的分析结构，并利用肯尼亚梅鲁县近期一项研究的数据展示其功能。我们讨论了当前模型的一些局限，并鼓励读者和从业者探索该工具，同时提出改进或更有效使用的建议。

title: Why do water points fail? Learning from open-ended failure descriptions in the WPDx dataset
venue: Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development
abstract: Despite the explosion of geospatial data collected on water points, there have been relatively few efforts to date to use these data to understand the correlates and potential causes of water point breakdowns. We add to this literature by coding open-ended responses around functionality status in the open-access WPDx (Water Point Data Exchange) database. We code responses into 41 different categories of functionality problems for 244,075 water points from 25 countries in Africa, Asia and Central America, though we narrow our analysis to 41,716 points in six countries. We find that descriptions of technical breakdowns or problems are most common, though concerns about water resources and water quality feature prominently. We also find that 7% of records in our analysis subset spontaneously mention concerns over vandalism or theft, something which has received relatively little attention in the sector. Information on user financial contributions is mostly omitted by uploaders to WPDx, but we find that users are not contributing at all in 40% of the 96,651 water points with these data. Our results should be interpreted cautiously considering the obvious selection and subjectivity concerns, but the analysis highlights the potential benefits of coordinating an augmented data collection standard.
abstract_zh: 尽管针对取水点收集的地理空间数据呈爆炸式增长，但迄今为止，利用这些数据理解取水点故障的相关因素及潜在原因的努力相对较少。我们通过对开放获取的WPDx（Water Point Data Exchange）数据库中关于运行状态的开放式回答进行编码，为这一文献作出补充。我们将回答编码为41类功能故障问题，涵盖来自非洲、亚洲和中美洲25个国家的244,075个取水点，不过我们将分析范围缩小至六个国家的41,716个取水点。我们发现，技术故障或问题的描述最为常见，但对水资源和水质的担忧也十分突出。我们还发现，在分析子样本中，7%的记录自发提及对破坏或盗窃的担忧，而这一问题在该领域受到的关注相对较少。上传者大多省略了用户的财务贡献信息，但我们发现，在有这些数据的96,651个取水点中，有40%的用户完全没有缴费。鉴于明显的选择性与主观性问题，我们的结果应谨慎解释，但该分析凸显了协调制定扩充数据收集标准的潜在益处。

Water markets and storage: Substitutes or complements for drought risk mitigation?
abstract: Are water storage and water markets complements or substitutes? This paper examines the conditions under which water storage for drought risk mitigation augments or attenuates water market gains from trade, and conversely, the conditions under which water markets augment or attenuate the value of additional water storage. The analysis is performed in the context of the Prior Appropriations doctrine in a fully appropriated basin. Two stylized examples based on water use at the intensive and extensive margin are provided, along with simulation results for proposed water storage projects and market development in the Yakima Basin in South-central Washington State.
abstract_zh: 水储存与水市场是互补还是替代关系？本文考察了在何种条件下，用于减缓干旱风险的水储存会增加或削弱水市场的贸易收益，反之，又在何种条件下，水市场会增加或削弱额外水储存的价值。该分析是在完全分配的流域中，依据“优先占用”（Prior Appropriations）原则进行的。我们提供了两个基于集约与外延用水边际的简化示例，并给出了华盛顿州中南部亚基马流域（Yakima Basin）中拟建水储存项目和市场发展的模拟结果。

title: Social comparisons, household water use and participation in utility conservation programs: Evidence from three randomized trials
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Regulation and political opposition often force water utilities to rely on nonprice approaches to manage water demand. Using randomized field experiments in three different water utilities, we assess the effectiveness of social comparisons to reduce demand and analyze their interaction with existing conservation programs. In two utilities, the program decreases consumption by 5%, with significant heterogeneity across the distribution of baseline water use. We do not detect a statistically significant average treatment effect in the third utility. Social norms do not appear to crowd out existing conservation programs: treated households are more likely to participate in additional programs. Of the two utilities with significant treatment effects, higher participation rates in conservation programs account for a very small fraction of water savings (3%) in one utility and a modest fraction (9%–25%) in the second. We discuss evidence that social norms may induce participation among the specific type of consumers that utilities wish to target.
abstract_zh: 监管和政治阻力常常迫使供水公司依赖非价格手段来管理用水需求。我们在三家不同的供水公司开展随机化现场实验，评估社会比较在减少需求方面的有效性，并分析其与现有节水项目的相互作用。在两家公司中，该项目使用水量减少了5%，并且在基线用水量的分布上存在显著的异质性。在第三家公司中，我们未检测到统计上显著的平均处理效应。社会规范并未挤出现有的节水项目：接受处理的家庭更有可能参加其他项目。在两家产生显著处理效应的公司中，节水项目参与率的提高仅占节水量的很小部分（3%）：其中一家为3%，另一家为9%–25%。我们讨论了相关证据，表明社会规范可能会促使供水公司希望针对的特定类型消费者参与节水。

title: The benefits and costs of informal sector pollution control: Traditional Mexican brick kilns
abstract: In developing countries, the rapid proliferation of informal firms – low-technology unlicensed micro-enterprises – is having significant environmental impacts. Yet environmental management authorities typically ignore such firms. This paper estimates the annual net benefits (benefits minus costs) of controlling particulate emissions from a collection of informal brick kilns in Ciudad Juárez, Mexico and from two of the city's leading formal industrial polluters. We find that the annual net benefits of controlling brick kiln emissions are substantial – in the tens of millions of dollars – and exceed those for the two formal industrial facilities by a significant margin. These results suggest that, in some cases, the conventional allocation of pollution control resources across formal and informal polluters may be suboptimal.
abstract_zh: 在发展中国家，非正规企业——技术水平低、未经许可的微型企业——的迅速扩散正产生重大的环境影响。然而，环境管理部门通常忽视此类企业。本文估算了控制墨西哥华雷斯城（Ciudad Juárez）一批非正规砖窑以及该市两家主要正规工业污染企业颗粒物排放的年度净收益（收益减去成本）。我们发现，控制砖窑排放的年度净收益十分可观，达数千万美元，并且大幅超过这两家正规工业设施的净收益。这些结果表明，在某些情况下，正规与非正规污染者之间污染控制资源的传统分配方式可能并不最优。
